newsitem.title: USA: Stocks extend losing streak to third day on Greenspan effect.
newsitem.headline: Stocks extend losing streak to third day on Greenspan effect.

text.p: Stocks ended lower for the third day in a row on Friday as the market remained under a cloud following Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's comments about high stock prices and hints about an interest rate hike.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed down 47.33 points at 6,877.74 after losing a more than 113 points since Greenspan made his comments on Wednesday. In the broader market, declining issues beat advances 14-10 on active volume of 511 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
